ican.text: I can explain the main ideas and use the notation for key features of graphs.
I can apply these ideas, show my working and check the result.

ku.text: A graph may have intercepts, turning points and asymptotes, subject to its domain.
A local maximum is higher than nearby values; it need not be the absolute maximum on the whole domain.
Read coordinates with appropriate accuracy and interpret features in context.

misc.weak: Calling the vertex coordinate $x=2$ the minimum value

terms.text: Give a reason that connects the mathematical idea to the situation.
Show enough working to make your method and answer clear.

worked.prompt: State the vertex and minimum of $f(x)=(x-2)^2+3$.

parts.label: Solution
parts.a: The vertex is $(2,3)$ and the minimum value is $3$.
